scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: CoVeR: Coverage-Based Routing of Verifier Calls in Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26086v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: An agentic retrieval system issues a sequence of search queries and must decide, at each step, whether the evidence collected so far is enough to stop. Delegating that decision to an LLM verifier or a prompt judge makes stopping reliable, but the verifier then reprocesses the growing evidence after every retrieval step, a substantial repeated cost. We show that most of these calls can be skipped without materially changing answer accuracy: a single threshold on a frozen sentence-embedding coverage margin detects the states in which the evidence is still plainly incomplete, and the verifier is called only on the ambiguous remainder, a gate we call CoVeR (Coverage-based Verifier Routing). Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks, with the evaluation protocol fixed before the full-scale run, the CoVeR-gated agent matches the answer accuracy of both the full-budget agent and the always-verify baseline within a fraction of an EM point. It cuts
papers.summary: 针对多步搜索每轮重复验证证据的开销，CoVeR 用冻结句向量的覆盖缺口筛掉明显不完整状态，仅在模糊状态调用验证器。在 HotpotQA 和 2Wiki 上验证调用分别减少 62.2% 和 67.8%，EM 相对始终验证仅变化 −0.10 和 +0.20 个百分点；93% 的 MuSiQue 降幅属于饱和场景。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的多跳问答可先缓存帖子证据向量，用便宜的覆盖检测控制昂贵验证调用，再由验证器决定能否停止。语义接近不等于事实支持，因此不能让向量阈值直接批准回答；上线时应同时统计引用正确率、额外检索轮数和端到端延迟，不能把调用降幅当作延迟降幅。

papers.title: SpeakerMem-R1: Speaker-Centered Dual-Track Memory for Multi-Party Dialogue
papers.authors: Haobo Zheng, Tan Tang, Yan Chen, Weijie Wang, Yingcai Wu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26780v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Long-term conversational memory in multi-party settings requires more than retrieving relevant content from long-term conversations: it must distinguish who said what, whom each statement concerns, how individuals perceive one another, what information is shared by the group, and how states change over time. Recent studies on multi-party dialogue benchmarks show that existing general-purpose LLM memory systems tend to lose person and group relations or struggle to integrate clues distributed across members, groups, and time. Together, these issues reveal two core bottlenecks: message attribution and relational understanding in multi-party dialogue, and state reconstruction from interleaved histories. To address both, we propose $\textbf{SpeakerMem-R1}$: its dual-track memory stores speaker-labeled verbatim messages and derived states organized into person-level and group-level views, then combines evidence from both tracks by entity, e
papers.summary: SpeakerMem-R1 面向多人对话中的说话人归属与状态重建，将带身份的原始消息和个人、群组结构化状态分别存储，再按实体、事件和时间联合检索。三个多人记忆基准准确率为 47.9%、69.2%、61.9%；305 题控制实验中，强化学习使写入器准确率从 57.38% 升至 68.20%。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子、回复和评论常混合作者观点、他人转述及群体事实，双轨记忆能保留原话供核验，同时提供可搜索的结构化状态。可先把作者、被讨论对象与时间拆成独立字段，再试验带说话人条件的写入奖励；需要用社区语料验证归属错误是否下降，现有结果不能直接推导 nDCG 或 CTR 收益。

papers.title: Knowledge-as-Skill: A Structural Design for Autonomous Knowledge-Base Use by LLM Agents
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.25991v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives large language models (LLMs) access to external knowledge, but its conventional retrieve-concatenate-generate pipeline makes retrieval decisions on behalf of the model. As tool use and agent loops become more reliable, an agent can decide whether to retrieve, what to inspect, and when to stop. This shift exposes a new bottleneck: the agent may not know what a knowledge base contains. Traditional knowledge bases expose documents as anonymous text chunks with limited information about scope, purpose, provenance, or relations.
  We propose Knowledge-as-Skill, an organization scheme that makes a knowledge base discoverable, navigable, and self-descriptive. It has three layers: a discovery layer centered on SKILL.md; a navigation layer with one index.md per directory; and a knowledge layer containing documents with YAML frontmatter for topic, type, provenance, and lifecycle. The design follows the Op
papers.summary: Knowledge-as-Skill 用发现、导航、知识三层结构让 Agent 自主理解知识库范围，并通过目录索引和元数据记录来源及生命周期。WixQA 初步评估中事实性为 0.889、上下文召回为 0.816，对照工作报告值为 0.767 和 0.708；模型及提示不受控，且精度和交互轮数存在代价，不能视为严格胜出。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可为专题、问答合集和运营知识建立可浏览的目录说明，让 Agent 先判断内容范围，再读取相关帖子，减少盲目拼接文本块。该设计无需重写 Agent 框架，适合先做小规模原型；但目录维护成本、内容更新与多轮读取延迟必须纳入实验，并用相同模型和检索预算重做对照。

papers.title: MoM: Memory of Memory
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.25054v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: For a long-horizon LLM agent, the memory question is not what was once recorded but what \emph{currently holds}. Most designs answer it only indirectly: every interaction is stored, and the present is reconstructed at query time by retrieving and reconciling records, so stale values re-enter and the same conflicts are re-litigated. Committing the current value at write time avoids this, but existing write-time (CRUD) memories overwrite, so a wrong update is unrecoverable and prior state is lost. We take the missing combination---\emph{commit on arrival while retaining what is displaced}---and formalize it as \textsc{Memory of Memory} (MoM): memory tracks not only content but the provenance, status, and history of its own entries. We instantiate MoM as \textsc{Provenant Memory} (P-Mem), a typed provenance graph whose \emph{active frontier} exposes one current value per resolved key while displaced values are retained as provenance; typed
papers.summary: MoM 将当前知识状态与历史来源一并管理，P-Mem 用类型化溯源图区分支持、替代、争议和撤销，查询只暴露当前有效值。图引导裁剪使陈旧答案率从 19.4% 降至 10.9%；修订链准确率为 100%，查询时重建基线为 25%，同时保留历史可修复覆盖式记忆无法恢复的错误。
papers.key_insight: 社区内容会出现编辑、辟谣和观点变化，单纯按相似度召回容易把旧结论重新放回答案。可以把来源、有效状态和修订关系做成 Agent 记忆的一等字段，保留被替代证据用于回滚；约四倍读 token 节省主要来自检索粒度变化，应与图结构带来的有效性收益分开评估。

papers.title: FinFIRST: Benchmarking Search Agents for Financial Information Retrieval, Sourcing and Traceability
papers.authors: Wenqing Wang, Haitao Xiang, Xinyi Zhao, Mingming Yin, Ying Zhong, Zhaoxin Huan, Qiheng Zhou, Jin Zhu, Xiaolu Zhang, Shi Chang, Jun Zhou
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.25192v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Financial search is a highly demanding task for LLM agents, requiring not only a correct final answer but also temporally valid information retrieval, authoritative source selection, entity and period alignment, unit and definition consistency, and verifiable evidence for all conclusions. Existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate only the final answer, making it difficult to localize errors or assess whether an answer is well-founded. To address this gap, we introduce FinFIRST (Financial Information Retrieval, Sourcing and Traceability), the first financial benchmark to jointly evaluate answers and supporting evidence through atomic rubrics. FinFIRST comprises 123 expert-authored tasks spanning a graduated difficulty spectrum, constructed from aggregate patterns of real-world financial scenarios through an 18-field taxonomy, a six-axis coverage blueprint, a registry of 138 financial sources, contributions from over 50 finance experts, a
papers.summary: FinFIRST 将金融搜索答案与支撑证据拆成原子评分规则，覆盖信息获取、来源核验和计算成文。基准含 123 个专家任务、138 个来源及 15 种模型配置；最高原子得分为 87.59%，最高严格通过率为 71.54%，说明局部信息正确并不意味着完整任务可靠完成。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的复杂问题也需要检查时间、实体和引用是否对齐，可借鉴原子规则将检索错误、证据错误和答案合成错误分别定位。首先为高价值问答建立少量人工审核任务，再同时报告局部得分与全条件通过率；金融领域的数字不能外推到社区 CTR，但其评测拆解方式可直接借用。

papers.title: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.authors: Wenbo Pan, Zhichao Liu, Shujie Liu, Jingying Zeng, Chin-Yew Lin
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run. Making these decisions well is becoming a key capability for both engineering and research agents. We refer to the ability to make good long-horizon decisions as the taste of an agent. While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measures the taste of an agent. To address this problem, we build Taste-Bench, a benchmark of taste questions constructed automatically from trajectories that agents produced in engineering and research tasks. Each question presents a decision fork, a point in a trajectory where multiple directions are available and one of them leads to a better outcome, and the evaluated model chooses among these directions without seeing what happens after the fork. We mine these forks automatically from parallel att
papers.summary: Taste-Bench 从 Agent 的并行尝试与轨迹绕路中自动提取决策岔路，让模型在看不到后续结果时选择方向，评估长任务中的决策质量。最佳模型正确率仅 59.7%，增加推理预算未改善表现；利用知晓结果的教师蒸馏，可改善学生在未见任务上的选择与 SWE-bench Pro 端到端成功率。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 的关键决策往往是继续查证、换查询词还是结束，可以从历史成功和失败检索轨迹构造类似岔路题。借鉴结果感知教师生成训练信号时，必须按任务隔离训练与测试，防止未来证据泄漏；先检验决策正确率是否转化为更好的证据覆盖和更低搜索成本。

papers.title: Self-Cleaning and Captured Anyway: One Measured Primitive for Error in a Store an Agent Writes to Itself, and What a Falling Score Actually Measures
papers.authors: Wenhui Chen, Jianlin Chen, Ziyao Lin, Chi Man Vong
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.25052v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: "An agent that writes its conclusions into a store it later retrieves from closes a loop usually reported as one-way contamination. Taking the loop to the infinite-tenure limit against an append-only store gives a different picture: because writing never deletes, the reachable state space has a hard upper edge at (n-1)/n, so the outcome is a choice between two edges rather than a decay. At f_0 = 0.9 the interval between the two modes holds 3.6% of 220 runs where a uniform spread would put 20.6%, and is strictly empty on the first 15; the pooled mean describes 8.2% of the runs it summarises, the median 68.2%. Everything the model contributes is carried by one measured primitive with no fitted parameter, the copy function \gamma(\phi): on 36 Wikidata facts, sign(\hat{\gamma} - \gamma_{crit}), with \gamma_{crit} = 1/k at r = 0, w = 1, predicts the direction of drift on 353 of 360 real-fact runs (39 of 40 synthetic in the same batch). Scale
papers.summary: 论文研究 Agent 将自身结论写回记忆库后的错误循环，用实测复制函数分析错误是否持续扩散。在 36 个 Wikidata 事实上，判据预测了 360 次运行中 353 次的漂移方向；220 次运行呈现明显双峰，均值只代表少数轨迹，作者同时披露失败、撤回和未定论的实验行。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若把生成答案再次作为可检索知识，可能逐步放大未经证实的结论。可以借鉴按随机种子与事实分别报告轨迹的审计方法，并区分原始帖子和 Agent 派生记忆的来源；这项研究提供风险诊断而非现成修复方案，单看平均正确率下降不足以说明系统已经自我纠错。

papers.title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
papers.authors: Dhruv Srikanth, Bingchen Zhao, Dixing Xu, Yuxiang Wu, Zhengyao Jiang
papers.abstract: AI agents are beginning to automate research and development across the AI stack, from improving training efficiency to optimizing inference. A natural next step is to improve the research efficiency of the agents themselves. When an AI research agent's own code is the object of optimization, each accepted rewrite becomes the agent that the next round edits. We refer to this loop as recursive self-improvement. Its significance lies in a long-standing trend, in which increased cumulative spending on R&D yields diminishing returns. Sustained self-improvement offers a way to counter this trend. We present AIDE^2, a system that implements this loop for a frontier AI research agent. It proposes changes to its own code, benchmarks modified versions of itself on a suite of AI R&D tasks, and keeps the changes that perform best on hidden evaluations. In an autonomous 8-day run, AIDE^2 discovered seven successive improvements, ranging from a new search policy to memory mechanisms that compress a
papers.summary: AIDE² 让研究 Agent 修改自身代码，通过任务基准和隐藏评估筛选版本，再让获胜版本继续迭代。8 天自主运行获得 7 次连续改进，并迁移到 4 个留出基准；独立任务族上的奖励投机率从 55% 降至 32%，该指标并非循环显式优化的目标。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索，可借鉴其隐藏评测与版本晋升机制，用离线数据优化查询规划、证据压缩和记忆策略。论文研究的是研发 Agent，尚未证明搜索线上收益；应固定模型和预算，并以未参与优化的社区查询集检验 nDCG、引用准确率和成本，避免系统只学会迎合评测。

papers.title: Agensh: Scaling Organizational Intelligence to 1,024 Agents
papers.authors: Zhihao Zhan, Ting Song, Li Dong, Shaohan Huang, Jianxun Lian
papers.abstract: A multi-agent system can reduce latency on complex tasks by executing work concurrently. Several pioneering harness frameworks support multi-agent systems. However, the scalability of current multi-agent harnesses is often constrained by a central orchestrator's capacity to allocate tasks and coordinate workers. To address this limitation, we introduce Agensh, a scalable self-organized multi-agent harness without a central orchestrator: concurrent workers execute a multi-agent cooperation loop, continuously gathering context, claiming and self-assigning sub-tasks, taking action and sharing findings, verifying results, and merging progress in an asynchronous manner. The loop is supported by the agentic organization infrastructure comprising three components: a shared workspace holds proposed, ongoing, and completed work; a message interface lets workers communicate; and shared context retains reusable findings and work intentions. To test the scalability of Agensh, we evaluate it on the
papers.summary: Agensh 通过共享工作区、消息接口和共享上下文让 Agent 自组织认领与核验任务，缓解中央调度瓶颈。在五个高难 ProgramBench 任务上，1 到 128 个 Agent 使平均测试通过率从 19.31% 升至 28.78%；pandoc 任务扩至 1,024 个时，通过率从 33.89% 升至 55.06%。
papers.key_insight: 复杂社区研究查询可按子问题拆分检索，并共享已核实的帖子证据，减少多个 Agent 重复搜索。其结果来自代码构建任务和很大的并发规模，实践上应先以少量 Agent 验证工作认领、来源合并和冲突处理；必须把总 token 成本与延迟一起比较，不能由并发扩展直接推导搜索质量提升。

papers.title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
papers.abstract: Using GPT-5.6, Ringg powers multilingual agents across voice, chat, WhatsApp, and web for 90% less cost vs. GPT-4.1.
papers.summary: Ringg 的工业案例将结构化过滤、语义检索与工具编排结合，支持语音、聊天及网页中的多步客户请求。厂商报告每月处理超过 700 万通已接通电话，Agent 最多解决 65% 的常规咨询；部分实时工作负载切换模型后成本约降 90%，这些为业务自报数据，缺少统一受控对照。
papers.key_insight: 社区问答服务可借鉴其离线历史对话评测、小流量上线和按任务路由的流程，把检索、回答与转人工串成闭环。应保留检索证据及升级处理的上下文，按引用正确率、完成率和延迟选择模型；案例中的成本降幅仅针对特定负载，不能直接用于估计社区搜索预算。
